code: case SEI_FILM_GRAIN_CHARACTERISTICS: i4_status = ih264d_parse_fgc(ps_bitstrm, ps_dec, ui4_payload_size);
note: The SEI payload type selects the film-grain parser, so attacker-controlled SEI bytes reach the vulnerable path.
The parser consumes the first control bit from the bitstream and uses it to decide whether to parse the rest of the film-grain structure.
When the cancel flag is clear, the parser continues into the variable-length field parsing that can overrun the bitstream.
The nested loops repeatedly read signed Exp-Golomb values from the same bitstream without a payload-size bound check.
The bit reader advances based on the requested bit count but does not enforce that the read stays within u4_max_ofst, so malformed SEI data can drive an out-of-bounds read.
The required safety predicate is that the next read must remain within the remaining bitstream size; the vulnerable path violates this bound and triggers the heap-buffer-overflow read.
